key_points: IBM launched self-hosted version of its AI coding agent 'Bob' for air‑gapped and sovereign environments.
Accenture's strong earnings and consulting demand lifted sentiment for IBM shares, driving intraday gains of ~2‑5%.
Board added Frank Baker, reinforcing dividend‑focused governance.
Despite recent positive moves, IBM remains down ~23% YTD, reflecting lingering valuation concerns.
Analyst views are mixed ahead of Q3 earnings, keeping upside potential cautious.
